title: 第322章 番外各路豪劫第321章 番外青梅竹马
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
“你怎么来了？”
烛龙被李君器声音吓了一跳，起身拍拍手笑道。
“前辈，你在干什么？”
李君器看着烛龙院子里各种瓶瓶罐罐，眨巴了一下眼睛。
“在酿酒，试试看自己手艺如何。”
烛龙表情不变，同时十分坦然说道。
懂不懂什么叫做灯下黑？
越是坦荡，怀疑的人越少。
同时烛龙发现，娲皇的隐藏性格也不老实。
一加入这个灌醉君肃计划后，娲皇那是各种奇思妙想尽出。
万灵土种出灵稻后，娲皇觉得还不够。
用灵稻酿出酒后，再把灵稻种子泡灵酒里，试试看能不能种出酒香稻。
接着，娲皇又打算从桃花和青梅下手。
这桃花更是无敌，娲皇直接打算找梦里桃花。
这玩意传说是天地意境之一，是在仙境才会出现的意韵。
很多强者顿悟，就是遇到了这种天地机缘。
除了梦里桃花外，还有黄粱一梦，沈青就是得了这机缘。
以及星河入梦、白驹过隙、杏花春雨、月落乌啼等等。
娲皇觉得拿梦里桃花这种意韵来酿酒，那必定是醉人动心。
烛龙和李君意一听，觉得是这么个理，于是采纳了娲皇的建议。

现在娲皇已经陷入她自己的艺术之中，无法自拔了。
“我有一件不错的差事，不知晓烛龙前辈有没有兴趣？”
李君器笑着搓手。
“没兴趣，我这边很忙。”
烛龙摆摆手，什么事能比灌醉君肃更有趣的？
“烛龙前辈别急着拒绝嘛，仔细看看。”
李君器没有退缩，反而笑着凑近。
烛龙肯定有兴趣。
“行吧，我看看。”
烛龙见此，拿过了灵晶。
很快她开始翻了起来，越翻，她眼底越带上了兴味。
“如何？”
李君器自得说道。
“还不错。”
“不过我本人不去。”
“这样吧，我到时候送道虚影进去，用神识操纵虚影。”
烛龙把灵晶递回去，耸肩说着。
酿酒这事她肯定走不开身，但逗皇子公主们玩也很有意思。
content_en:
"Why are you here?"
Zhulong was startled by Li Junqi's voice, stood up, clapped his hands and smiled.
"Senior, what are you doing?"
Li Junqi looked at the various bottles and jars in Zhulong's yard and blinked.
"I'm making wine, try my hand at it."
Zhulong's expression remained unchanged and he spoke very calmly.
Do you know what it means to be dark under the lamp?
The more magnanimous you are, the fewer people will doubt you.
At the same time, Zhulong discovered that Emperor Wa's hidden character was not honest either.
Once he joined the plan to get Jun Su drunk, Emperor Wa came up with all kinds of fantastic ideas.
After Wan Ling Tu planted spiritual rice, Emperor Wa felt it was not enough.
After brewing wine from spiritual rice, soak the spiritual rice seeds in spiritual wine to see if you can grow wine-flavored rice.
Then, Emperor Wa planned to start with peach blossoms and green plums.
This peach blossom is even more invincible, and Emperor Wa directly plans to find the peach blossom in his dream.
This thing is said to be one of the artistic conceptions of heaven and earth, and it is an artistic conception that only appears in fairyland.
Many strong people have epiphanies because they encounter this kind of opportunity.
In addition to the peach blossoms in the dream, there is also a dream of Huang Liang, and Shen Qing got this opportunity.
As well as the stars falling into a dream, the white horse passing through the gap, the apricot blossoms in the spring rain, the moon falling and the crows crying, etc.
Emperor Wa felt that using the connotation of peach blossoms in dreams to make wine would be intoxicating and tempting.
When Zhulong and Li Junyi heard this, they thought it made sense, so they adopted Emperor Wa's suggestion.
Now Wahuang was trapped in her own art and could not extricate herself.
"I have a nice errand. I wonder if Senior Zhulong is interested?"
Li Junqi smiled and rubbed his hands.
"No interest, I'm very busy here."
Zhulong waved his hand, what could be more interesting than getting Jun Su drunk?
"Senior Zhulong, don't refuse in a hurry. Take a closer look."
Li Junqi did not flinch, but leaned closer with a smile.
Zhulong is definitely interested.
"Okay, let me take a look."
Seeing this, Zhulong took the spiritual crystal.
Soon she started to turn it over, and the more she turned it over, the more interesting it became in her eyes.
"How?"
Li Junqi said proudly.
"Not bad."
"But I'm not going myself."
"Let's do this, I will send the phantom in when the time comes, and use my spiritual consciousness to control the phantom."
Zhulong handed the spiritual crystal back and said with a shrug.
She will definitely not be able to get away from making wine, but it is also fun to entertain the princes and princesses.
